beamngEarth.hud.altitude.name: BeamNG.Earth: Altitude
beamngEarth.hud.altitude.description: Your height above sea level and above the ground, and how fast you climb or fall.
beamngEarth.hud.banner.name: BeamNG.Earth: Connection
beamngEarth.hud.banner.description: What is wrong with the world server and what to do (hidden while all is well).
beamngEarth.hud.credits.name: BeamNG.Earth: Data credits
beamngEarth.hud.credits.description: The sources of the map data around you (their licences ask for visible credit).
beamngEarth.hud.status.name: BeamNG.Earth: Status bar
beamngEarth.hud.status.description: Street, town and country, and the world loading (BeamNG.Earth).
beamngEarth.controls.devToggle.title: BeamNG.Earth: toggle dev overlays
beamngEarth.controls.devToggle.desc: Turns the last-used BeamNG.Earth dev tools preset on (default: LOD), or everything off. Unbound by default.
beamngEarth.controls.wireframe.title: BeamNG.Earth: wireframe view
beamngEarth.controls.wireframe.desc: Shows the world as triangle edges (how the ground, the far terrain and the roads are built), or turns it off again (Ctrl+Alt+W).
beamngEarth.controls.reportNote.title: BeamNG.Earth: report an issue / idea
beamngEarth.controls.reportNote.desc: Captures a screenshot, the location, the performance and your hardware now, and opens a window to describe a map issue, performance issue, bug or idea; saves a ready-to-post GitHub issue (Ctrl+Shift+E).
beamngEarth.controls.reportBench.title: BeamNG.Earth: performance profiler (30 s)
beamngEarth.controls.reportBench.desc: Records 30 s of frame times while you drive, then opens the report window for a performance issue (Ctrl+Shift+Y).
beamngEarth.controls.nearestStation.titl: BeamNG.Earth: route to the nearest station
beamngEarth.controls.nearestStation.desc: Sets the GPS to the nearest gas station, or the nearest EV charger for an electric car (Ctrl+Shift+Q). The low fuel prompt names this key.
beamngEarth.controls.mapToggle.title: BeamNG.Earth: world map
beamngEarth.controls.mapToggle.desc: Opens the BeamNG.Earth world map (where you are, saved places, click to teleport), or closes it. In our level the game's map key (M) and the pause menu's Map open it; unbound by default (bind a key here if you like).
beamngEarth.controls.map3dToggle.title: BeamNG.Earth: 3D map
beamngEarth.controls.map3dToggle.desc: Flies the camera up from the car into the 3D map (move with WASD or the left stick, turn and tilt with the mouse or the right stick, zoom with the wheel), or back down to the car. Unbound by default; the map key opens it when Settings > Interface > Map style is 3D.
